description:
The Client Requires support, maintenance, and documentation of its current systems which include Oracle APEX applications and Oracle Business Intelligence (OBIEE). 
 Scope includes: 
 Maintenance of APEX (Version 5.1.2.00.09 on Oracle Database 12.1.0.2.0) and BI (Version 11.1.1.7.140715 Build 140622.1831 64-bit) systems 
 Documentation and knowledge transfer of new and existing APEX functionality and OBIEE reporting 
 Address help desk cases and enhancements utilizing OMES procedures  
 Weekly status reports including work completed and current and future tasks 
 Technical work, requirements gathering, user interaction 
 Tasks involved pre- and post-processing (front- and back-end) of reports utilizing Oracle and other systems 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
